title: Hearth of Thorns
shortDescription: Living briar holds the glass and the light.
longDescription:
The Hearth of Thorns is half cloister and half greenhouse. Briar has been trained into trellises that remember every cut, and green light pools on the stone like water held in a leaf. Shears hang where a first-year can reach them and a second-year has learned not to rush. The air smells of crushed sap, damp earth, and the faint sweetness of something flowering out of season.
Mentor Briar waits among the living walls as if the plants had asked her to stay.
A straw hearth dummy stands where a lesson can be finished without guessing.

fixtures.name: Mentor Briar
fixtures.lookDescription: A scarred hedgehog in a green cloak caught with thorns, shears at the belt. Try talk briar.
fixtures.examineDescription: Briar's quills are patched with old scratches. The cloak is mended with vine-thread. She speaks as if the plants were listening, and they usually are.
fixtures.dialogue: "Look around this hearth. The briar remembers every cut. Defeat the hearth dummy in this room. Come back and talk to me. I will ink three leaves in your Field Primer."

welcome.text: "Green light. Crushed sap. Shears where you can reach them. Look around this hearth. The plants are listening. Then attack the hearth dummy in this room — not Flint's orchard dummy, unless you are still learning the spark. Come back and talk to me. I will ink three leaves."

craft.text: "The Field Primer is your book, not a pressed flower. I pen the first three leaves after you look around this hearth, defeat the dummy, and talk to me. Later the page offers three choices. Type 1, 2, or 3. Growth that is not named will snare you."

go.text: "Look around this hearth. Defeat the dummy. I will be here among the living walls. The shears stay sharp. So do I."

lessons-done.text: "The three starter leaves are inked. Cast briar at the hearth dummy for the second lesson — a vine trained, not a snare left to wander. After that, the Primer will offer three leaves. Type 1, 2, or 3."

third-lesson.text: "Talk to Headmaster Alder in the High Study. Type up from the Great Hall. If he is still sending you down the Clock Tower stair, finish that first. When he says the grounds will teach the rest, come back and talk to me."

third-done.text: "College lessons in this hearth are complete. Keep the Primer. Each new lesson opens three leaves. I still sign the page even when I am not at your shoulder. Holm kept a stair so first-years would not walk it dark. Eat something warm before you take a cold road."

fixtures.name: Briar Trellis
fixtures.examineDescription: The living wood has been trained into a door that is also a warning. New growth is tied, not broken. A slate says: 'Ask before you cut.'
